notEstablished: This slot exists because the witness stage used to key its output directory by the lane directory name. Every application `acquire` fetches is written to `.versionless/work/<id>/baseline`, so every acquired application shared one `baseline/` slot and each run overwrote the last one's record. The key is now the acquisition identity, which is the name of this directory.

The record inside this directory is byte-identical to the one published under the shared key: its `application` field still reads `baseline`, which is the key the run that produced it was given. It was not rewritten, because `evidence/runs/react-flame-v2-4-0/run-record.json` pins its canonical digest and that run record is history. The identity of the application this slot belongs to is stated here rather than edited into a sealed digest.
Nothing here re-runs, re-measures or re-adjudicates the witness run. This file records where a file moved and what it hashes to, and nothing about what the replay established.
